packs.title: Map of your region (Protomaps basemap)
packs.description: A vector map cut out of the Protomaps world basemap for the area you choose. Protomaps publishes the whole world (over 100 GB), so you cut your own piece with the pmtiles tool, then import the file here.
packs.recipe: pmtiles extract https://build.protomaps.com/<a current build>.pmtiles my-region.pmtiles --bbox=<west>,<south>,<east>,<north> --maxzoom=11   (builds are listed at maps.protomaps.com/builds; the pmtiles tool is at github.com/protomaps/go-pmtiles)
packs.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Basemap by Protomaps.
